params.published: CVLFace cvlface/pretrained_models/README.md 'Face Recognition Performance Board', row IR101 / AdaFace / WebFace12M: AVG 92.13, LFW 99.82, CPLFW 94.57, CFP-FP 99.24, CALFW 96.12, AgeDB 98.00, IJB-B TAR@FAR=1e-4 96.46, IJB-C TAR@FAR=1e-4 97.72, TinyFace R1 72.42 / R5 74.81
params.precision_note: fp16 autocast chosen by the E1 rule (reports/E1_recognition: min cos(fp16, fp32) 0.99993 over 62,000 images, max |delta acc| 0.03 pp); E1 itself ran with fp16=false in MODEL.json and measured both
